name: vale
description: Hands-free, voice-first assistant for entrepreneurs who work with their hands. Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon 2026.

scripts.start: trap 'kill $SRV_PID 2>/dev/null' INT TERM; P="${PORT:-${VOICE_PORT:-3000}}"; tsx --env-file=.env server.ts & SRV_PID=$!; SRV_PID="$SRV_PID" P="$P" node -e 'const {WebSocket}=require("ws");const port=process.env.P,pid=Number(process.env.SRV_PID),end=Date.now()+45000;(function tick(){try{process.kill(pid,0);}catch(e){console.error("npm start: server exited before /voice came up (see [voice-server] error above).");process.exit(1);}if(Date.now()>end){console.error("npm start: /voice did not accept a WebSocket on :"+port+" within 45 s.");process.exit(1);}const ws=new WebSocket("ws://localhost:"+port+"/voice");ws.on("open",function(){ws.close();process.exit(0);});ws.on("error",function(){setTimeout(tick,500);});})();' || { RC=$?; kill $SRV_PID 2>/dev/null; wait $SRV_PID 2>/dev/null; exit $RC; }; echo "Vale is live at http://localhost:$P (voice on /voice)"; wait $SRV_PID
scripts.test:audio: vitest run asr route capture agent
